basic_info.description: Bright, welcoming, and full of potential, this Ingleside Heights residence offers 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and 1,130 sq ft of living space. The homes southern exposure fills it with natural light and showcases remarkable views of both the San Bruno Mountains and San Francisco. Inside, youll find two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath, along with a unique floor plan that includes a spacious loft area and flexible layout inviting future expansion. The home also features a bonus potential in-law space downstairsperfect for guests, multigenerational living, or added income opportunities. A rare two-car garage adds practicality for vehicles, storage, or hobbies. The surrounding neighborhood enhances the appeal, with convenient access to shopping and dining at Stonestown Galleria, the all-new H Mart, Ocean Avenue, and West Portal. Outdoor escapes like Lake Merced and Ocean Beach are minutes away, while the San Francisco Zoo and SFSU bring additional neighborhood character. For commuters, the home is ideally located near Muni, BART, and I-280, providing simple connections throughout the city and beyond. This is a wonderful chance to own a home with views, bonus space, and an exceptional location.
